candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations (fast, ~1ms), causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 propagating through order to gateway; payment logs confirm repeated 503 on /v1/authorizations.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment 503 root cause (config, dependency, or code) not established; only the failing hop is bounded.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s trace to order returning 502, which traces to payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations. Payment logs show repeated 503s. Inventory/redis succeed. The failing hop is bounded to payment; its internal cause is not yet established.
